plugins.name: ctrl-freaq
plugins.description: GitHub issue/PR pipeline — draft, research, slice, plan, resolve, and evaluate issues end-to-end via the gh CLI, plus standalone setup, question, doc-review, requirements-gathering, workspace-lifecycle and review-report tools, and a coordinator that drives an issue or epic through every stage from one session. Deterministic work runs in bundled stdlib-only Python scripts, beside an optional read-only board mod.
